title: Counterattack
author: MelonadeM
rights: Demo songs are not under the GPL; all rights reserved to their original authors.
timing: Preserve every register value and its order. Convert absolute 44100 Hz VGM sample times to half-period ticks at the project's fixed 8 MHz clock using integer floor. Serialize each complete address/data transaction through Bus.reg (512 ticks), extending port-0 rhythm key register 0x10 transactions to 1248 ticks to wait 576 master clocks after data WR releases at start+96. Writes in the same sample retain their order and advance the next transaction as required by these documented waits. This is a real register stream expanded with manual bus waits; the source event times are retained separately, and the expanded event times can differ. The source's 7.9872 MHz clock is adapted to the project's 8 MHz clock.
